messages:
maya: quick follow-up from the RFC review — proposing an "autoswitch" safety-net for canary/A-B rollouts. want oncall + runtime ops feedback before we land.
alex_k: high level: if canary crosses latency/err/quality thresholds we auto-route matching traffic to stable variant. keep decisions local to edge router + decision service.
sasha: concern: conversation state. if a canary model uses different kv cache keys/format we risk users getting inconsistent context after switch. do we require state compatibility gate?
maya: yes. plan is to require a "state_compatibility" boolean on model manifest. if false, autoswitch will fallback only for new sessions, not mid-conversation.
tom_ops: oncall perspective: need clear signals we alert on. suggest 3 signals: 99p latency, error-rate over 1m, and quality-regression from quick evals.
oncall-bot: ALERT_POLICY tip: attach runbook link when creating the alert. see #incidents/runbooks.
alex_k: tradeoff: conservative thresholds reduce incidents but make canaries less useful. we should support adaptive thresholds per-tenant (high-volume apps get tighter SLOs).
maria-eng: for rollout surface, we need to support two switch modes: soft-switch (probabilistic reweighting over 30m) and hard-redirect (instant). soft-switch preserves cache hit rates better.
sasha: implementation note: decision service should keep a small memory of recent routing decisions to prevent flip-flop on borderline signals. implement a short cooldown per (model, route, tenant).
maya: config sketch:
```
autoswitch_config: {
  "signals": ["latency_99p", "error_rate_1m", "eval_quality_delta"],
  "modes": {"soft": {"window_mins": 30}, "hard": {"cooldown_secs": 300}},
  "state_compatibility_required": true,
  "per_tenant_overrides": true
}
```
alex_k: Ops ops: need a clear playbook for manual takeover. autoswitch must surface the cause & last metric snapshot into console and post to #oncall when triggered.
tom_ops: +1. add an automatic rollback timer: if autoswitch happened and stable route is unhealthy for >10m, escalate to oncall and pause further autoswitches.
maya: will add to RFC. anyone object to me proceeding with a prototype PR for decision-service + edge-router hooks?
sasha: go for it. please include a simulation harness for flip-flop tests.
maria-eng: I'll stub the telemetry annotations so we can link metric deltas to session ids in traces.
ci-bot: quick CI note: add integration tests that simulate canary latency spikes and validate autoswitch and cooldown logic.
maya: thanks all — i'll open the PR and reference this thread. ping me in DMs for followups. :thumbsup:
